records.jp: 大きなクラックに、勇希がいなくなったり……。<CR>信じられないことばかり起きるなあ、ほんと
records.en_original: First that big Crack, then Yuki disappearing... The unbelievable keeps on happening.
records.en_auxiliary: First that big Crack, then Yuki disappearing... The unbelievable keeps on happening.
records.en: A huge Crack, Yuki disappearing...<CR>One unbelievable thing after another keeps happening.

records.jp: でも、すべて事実。<CR>これを乗り越えないと、先はない
records.en_original: And yet it is all real. If we do not overcome this, there will be no future for us.
records.en_auxiliary: And yet it is all real. If we do not overcome this, there will be no future for us.
records.en: But it's all real.<CR>If we can't overcome this, there's no way forward.

records.jp: ……そうだね。<CR>うん、頑張らないと
records.en_original: ...Yeah. You're right. We have to try.
records.en_auxiliary: ...Yeah. You're right. We have to try.
records.en: ...You're right.<CR>Yeah, we have to keep trying.

records.jp: 何か聞きたいこととかある？
records.en_original: Was there something you wanted to ask me?
records.en_auxiliary: Was there something you wanted to ask me?
records.en: Was there something you wanted to ask me?

records.jp: この世界には管理者が必要で、<CR>100万年にいちどの周期で管理者は再度選ばれる
records.en_original: So this world needs an overseer, and a new one is selected once every million years...
records.en_auxiliary: So this world needs an overseer, and a new one is selected once every million years...
records.en: This world needs an overseer,<CR>and a new one is chosen once every million years.

records.jp: そんな世界のシステムに、管理者不在という異常が<CR>発生している……んだよね？
records.en_original: And the World System considers the absence of an overseer to be an anomaly. Right?
records.en_auxiliary: And the World System considers the absence of an overseer to be an anomaly. Right?
records.en: And the World System is experiencing an anomaly<CR>because there is no overseer... right?

records.jp: 恐らく
records.en_original: Probably.
records.en_auxiliary: Probably.
records.en: Probably.

records.jp: 恐らく？
records.en_original: Probably?
records.en_auxiliary: Probably?
records.en: Probably?

records.jp: 私たち人間の理解ではそういうことになってる
records.en_original: That is what we have concluded, based on our understanding.
records.en_auxiliary: That is what we have concluded, based on our understanding.
records.en: That is what we have concluded, based on our understanding.

records.jp: でも、世界の仕組みなんて、人間に理解できるとは<CR>限らない
records.en_original: But the mechanisms of this world tend to go beyond human comprehension.
records.en_auxiliary: But the mechanisms of this world tend to go beyond human comprehension.
records.en: But there is no guarantee<CR>that humans can understand how the world works.

records.jp: リンゴは木から落ちるけれど、もしかしたら世界が<CR>リンゴに向かって落ちているのかもしれない
records.en_original: We think that apples fall from trees, but perhaps the world falls towards the apple.
records.en_auxiliary: We think that apples fall from trees, but perhaps the world falls towards the apple.
records.en: An apple falls from a tree,<CR>but perhaps the world is falling toward the apple.

records.jp: だから、仮に管理者不在を解消したとしても、<CR>灰が降りやむとは限らない
records.en_original: So it is possible that the Ash would've fallen on our world even if there was an overseer.
records.en_auxiliary: So it is possible that the Ash would've fallen on our world even if there was an overseer.
records.en: So even if we fill the vacant overseer position,<CR>that doesn't necessarily mean the Ash will stop falling.

records.jp: ……なるほど
records.en_original: ...I see.
records.en_auxiliary: ...I see.
records.en: ...I see.

records.jp: 逆に言えば、思いもしない簡単なことで<CR>灰が降りやむかもしれないね
records.en_original: By that same logic, maybe it's simpler than we think. The Ash could just stop falling at some point.
records.en_auxiliary: By that same logic, maybe it's simpler than we think. The Ash could just stop falling at some point.
records.en: Conversely, some unexpectedly simple action<CR>might make the Ash stop.

records.jp: リンゴを空に放り投げれば、不在の管理者枠に<CR>スポッとはまるかもしれない
records.en_original: And if we throw an apple into the sky...it might  land right where our missing overseer should be.
records.en_auxiliary: And if we throw an apple into the sky...it might  land right where our missing overseer should be.
records.en: If we toss an apple into the sky,<CR>it might pop right into the vacant overseer slot.

records.jp: あ、あきれた？
records.en_original: A-am I annoying you?
records.en_auxiliary: A-am I annoying you?
records.en: A-are you appalled?

records.jp: 感心した。<CR>どうやったら、そんなポジティブな発想ができるの？
records.en_original: No, no. I'm moved. However do you manage to stay so positive?
records.en_auxiliary: No, no. I'm moved. However do you manage to stay so positive?
records.en: I'm impressed.<CR>How do you come up with such positive ideas?

records.jp: 聞かないで！
records.en_original: It's a secret!
records.en_auxiliary: It's a secret!
records.en: Don't ask!

records.jp: ……他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: 外の世界は無事だと思う？
records.en_original: Do you think the outside world is okay?
records.en_auxiliary: Do you think the outside world is okay?
records.en: Do you think the outside world is okay?

records.jp: あなた自身が、きっと大丈夫だって言ってたじゃない
records.en_original: That's what you've been saying, isn't it?
records.en_auxiliary: That's what you've been saying, isn't it?
records.en: That's what you've been saying, isn't it?

records.jp: それはそうだけど！<CR>やっぱり不安というか……
records.en_original: Well, yeah! But I am still worried...
records.en_auxiliary: Well, yeah! But I am still worried...
records.en: That's true!<CR>But I still feel uneasy...

records.jp: 私もわからない。<CR>だから、いろんな可能性を考えておくしかない
records.en_original: I don't know either. So you should prepare yourself for whatever awaits on the other side.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know either. So you should prepare yourself for whatever awaits on the other side.
records.en: I don't know either.<CR>That's why we have to consider every possibility.

records.jp: いろんな可能性……
records.en_original: Whatever awaits...
records.en_auxiliary: Whatever awaits...
records.en: Whatever awaits...

records.jp: 外の世界が無事なら、そこにいる人たちは<CR>この世界にどうにか入ろうとしているのかも
records.en_original: If the outside world is okay, then the people there might be trying to find a way into this world.
records.en_auxiliary: If the outside world is okay, then the people there might be trying to find a way into this world.
records.en: If the outside world is safe, the people there<CR>may be trying to find a way into this world.

records.jp: そうだとすると、どうやってこの世界に入る？<CR>そう推測をたてて、連絡を取る手がかりを探るの
records.en_original: In which case, we'd need to figure out how they could get in, and look for signs of contact.
records.en_auxiliary: In which case, we'd need to figure out how they could get in, and look for signs of contact.
records.en: Then how would they enter this world?<CR>We can form hypotheses and search for signs of contact.

records.jp: もし外の世界が無事じゃなかったら？
records.en_original: And if the outside world isn't okay?
records.en_auxiliary: And if the outside world isn't okay?
records.en: And if the outside world isn't okay?

records.jp: 私たちが考えるべきは、外の世界をどうにか救う方法、<CR>ということになる
records.en_original: Then what we would need to do is to think of a way to save it.
records.en_auxiliary: Then what we would need to do is to think of a way to save it.
records.en: Then what we need to consider<CR>is how to save the outside world.

records.jp: （正直、どちらも全然見当がつかない……）
records.en_original: (I don't have a clue how to do either of those things...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I don't have a clue how to do either of those things...)
records.en: (I don't have a clue how to do either of those things...)

records.jp: 他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: 最近思うの。<CR>みんな私のことをペットって思ってるんじゃないかって
records.en_original: I've been thinking. Haven't you all been treating me like some kind of pet?
records.en_auxiliary: I've been thinking. Haven't you all been treating me like some kind of pet?
records.en: I've been thinking lately.<CR>Maybe everyone sees me as a pet.

records.jp: それはまたなんで？
records.en_original: Huh? What makes you say that?
records.en_auxiliary: Huh? What makes you say that?
records.en: Huh? What makes you say that?

records.jp: やたら髪を弄りたがる。<CR>お菓子で餌付けしようとしてくる
records.en_original: The way you always play with my hair, or try to feed me sweets.
records.en_auxiliary: The way you always play with my hair, or try to feed me sweets.
records.en: You're always trying to play with my hair.<CR>You keep trying to tame me with sweets.

records.jp: 姿を見かけたら追いかけまわしてくる。<CR>ちょっと、疲れる……
records.en_original: Or how you chase me down whenever you spot me. It's tiring...
records.en_auxiliary: Or how you chase me down whenever you spot me. It's tiring...
records.en: Whenever you see me, you chase me around.<CR>It's a little tiring...

records.jp: まあ……それだけ愛されてるってことだよ
records.en_original: Well...that's just because we all love you.
records.en_auxiliary: Well...that's just because we all love you.
records.en: Well...that's just because we all love you.

records.jp: むう……
records.en_original: Hmph...
records.en_auxiliary: Hmph...
records.en: Hmph...

records.jp: あっ、この匂い……ご飯かな？
records.en_original: Oh, that smell... Is dinner almost ready?
records.en_auxiliary: Oh, that smell... Is dinner almost ready?
records.en: Oh, that smell... Is dinner almost ready?

records.jp: （早く食べに行きたそう……。<CR>胃袋はすっかり懐柔されてしまっているようだ）
records.en_original: (She looks like she's dying to eat. I guess the way to her heart really is through her stomach.)
records.en_auxiliary: (She looks like she's dying to eat. I guess the way to her heart really is through her stomach.)
records.en: (She looks eager to go eat...<CR>It seems her stomach has been thoroughly won over.)

records.jp: ……他に聞きたいことはある？
records.en_original: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en_auxiliary: Is there anything else you want to ask about?
records.en: Is there anything else you want to ask about?

records.jp: ううん、大丈夫。<CR>それじゃあ、またね
records.en_original: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
records.en_auxiliary: No, that's all. I'll see you later.
records.en: No, that's all.<CR>See you later.
